the computer simulation is useful in predicting the effects of babesiosis control strategies on the survival of B. bovis in its vector and host.

babesiosis control is most effectively achieved by reducing the tick burden to levels below the threshold for disease transmission, and that tick-resistant cattle are an effective means of reducing tick burdens to these levels.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the tick burden is the key variable in determining whether or not an outbreak occurs.
babesiosis outbreaks are associated with tick burdens that are too high to maintain the herd in a state of immunological stability.
babesiosis outbreaks can occur at tick burdens well below the threshold for clinical babesiosis.
